exact_pixel_duplicate_policy: Keep the first deterministic identity-audit record in each exact-pixel duplicate group; exclude the remaining aliases from target evaluations and within-site controls.

resampling.design: Each repetition randomly partitions all target positive images into disjoint calibration and evaluation halves, then samples n+ positives without replacement from the calibration half. Negative evaluation images are independently partitioned for each repetition.
resampling.unit_weight_w_crc_note: W-CRC with unit calibration/test weights equals CRC and is omitted as a duplicate method row.
